title: centaurium grandiflorum subsp. boissieri
intro: Centaurium grandiflorum subsp. boissieri, commonly known as Mountain Centaury or Boissier's Centaury, is a plant species within the Gentianaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to the relief of digestive issues, colds, and fever. The therapeutic actions of Centaurium grandiflorum subsp. boissieri include expectorant and diuretic effects, which may help with respiratory and urinary system issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
